conditions: App developers using Vungle SDK must update the user's COPPA status.
effects: Collects children's online privacy protection act (COPPA) status of a user.
Affects how the user's data is handled in term of COPPA regulations.

conditions: If the user is under the age of 13 and falls under COPPA regulations.
effects: Sets the user's COPPA status to 'true', meaning the user is under the age of 13 and falls under COPPA regulations.

conditions: If the user is older than 13 and does not fall under COPPA regulations.
effects: Sets the user's COPPA status to 'false', meaning the user doesn't fall under COPPA regulations.
